name: diabolic servitude
mana cost: {3}{B}
types: enchantment
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
triggered: when the creature put onto the battlefield with CARDNAME dies, exile it and return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
triggered: when CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, exile the creature put onto the battlefield with CARDNAME.
replacement: forget remembered card if it goes into exile.
replacement: forget remembered card if it goes into hand.
replacement: forget remembered card if it goes into library.
